    • configMap

      public Map<String,String> configMap()
      Description copied from interface: ServiceConfig
      Convert the structured config to a type erased config map.

      A map-valued field becomes one entry, under the field's option name, whose value is a JSON object string, such as assume_role_session_tags = {"Team":"data"}. The map's entries are not flattened into top-level entries. Its keys are sorted, an empty map becomes {}, and an unset field has no entry.

      Specified by:
      configMap in interface ServiceConfig
      Returns:
      the config map
